_about: Figure 3 timeline ranges. Every value drawn in figure3() is read from this file; no range literal is typed into a drawing call. Values are curated by hand and each entry names the evidence it rests on ('source', and 'rows' where study rows underpin it). Ratings are the adjudicated certainty ratings from synthesis/SWIM_NARRATIVE.md. build_figures.py validates this file (it stops if the file is missing or malformed) and prints every range with its source into validation_table.txt.
decimal_year_convention: A calendar year Y is drawn as the interval [Y.00, (Y+1).00); a bar closed at Y.99 therefore covers through December of year Y. A month M of year Y maps to Y + (M-1)/12 (month-start convention), so November 2014 is 2014.83.
